caption:
Vague prompt, vague answer? 🤔 Let the AI interview you first.

Paste this: "Before you answer, ask me up to 5 questions you need to do this well."

Answer them, then get a reply made for you. 📌 Save this prompt.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #aitools #promptengineering #aitips #productivity #techtips #learnai #techmendly

scenes.text: Why does AI give you generic answers?
scenes.say: Why does AI give you generic answers? It is missing your details.

scenes.title: Let the AI ask first
scenes.code: Before you answer, ask me up to 5 questions.
scenes.say: Here is the trick. Add one line to your prompt. Before you answer, ask me up to five questions.

scenes.title: AI chat
scenes.user: Plan my week of study. Before you answer, ask me up to 5 questions.
scenes.reply:
Happy to help!
1. What are you studying?
2. How many hours a day?
3. When is your exam?
scenes.say: Watch what happens. The AI does not guess. It asks what subject, how many hours, and when your exam is.

scenes.title: Answer, then get a tailored plan
scenes.say: Answer each question briefly. Add anything it missed. Then ask for the final result. It is built around you.

scenes.label: quick questions replace a vague guess with your real details
scenes.say: Five quick questions replace a vague guess with your real details.
